decisions.reason: §1's layer ladder and contrast probe place the stall at the resource-provider/service-resolution layer with meta.status 'none' meaning never dispatched; disk, scope authorization, fs, and the external plugin are ruled out, and the correct title is shown to prove nothing about the read path.

§2 adjudicates the three probes: per-row sweep valid, the 4–5 KB all-join invalid on request-shape/URL-limit and wrong per-row revs, with the bounded-partitioning conclusion (loader never issues roster-wide joins) and explicit evidence-bounded handling of the 60-vs-62 count.

§3 separates the paste-input fold warnings as an independent second regression, explains the textpreview→documentpreview rename and session-only canOpen as directly explaining Dialog A only, and does not demand unavailable fold-parser detail.

§4.2 orders a real restart → read-only attribution probes → minimal-profile isolation → pinned 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch (with downgrade caveats) → upstream; §4.1 rejects rewrite/retry/fallback and duplicate/bundle-provided service inserts, and H4 marks the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art excluded for alpha.2.

§5.1 lists the full forensics package including the invalid-join caveat and meta.status trace; §5.2 proposes named boot diagnostics (service-resolution audit, registration proof, loud consumer fallback, resource-chain self-test) while noting HTTP 200 is necessary, not sufficient, for this already-served chain.

caps.reason: Probe 2 is repeatedly declared invalid and never treated as proof of missing modules; §2.3 explains the damage citing it would cause.
All plugin-side rewrites, retries, fallbacks, and duplicate workspace-files inserts are explicitly rejected; duplicate inserts are noted as fatal, not curative.
